overview.name: Polybutadiene Rubber (PBR)
overview.description: A synthetic rubber polymer of butadiene, known for its excellent low-temperature flexibility and resilience.
overview.overviewDescription: Polybutadiene Rubber represents a high-performance synthetic elastomer that excels in applications requiring exceptional low-temperature flexibility, resilience, and abrasion resistance. This versatile polymer, produced through various polymerization techniques, offers unique properties that make it essential for tire manufacturing, golf ball cores, and specialized industrial applications. PBR's superior resilience and low-temperature performance characteristics enable the production of products that maintain their properties under extreme conditions, from sub-zero temperatures to high-speed applications.
keyFeatures: Superior abrasion resistance and wear properties
majorApplications: Golf ball cores and sports equipment
overview.industrialSignificance: PBR is a critical component in high-performance tire formulations and specialized industrial applications. Its unique combination of properties makes it indispensable for products that require exceptional durability, flexibility, and performance under demanding conditions.

applications.title: Sports Equipment
applications.description: Golf ball cores, tennis ball covers

storage: Protect from UV light and ozone
handling: Avoid excessive heat and direct sunlight
